Client & Bidding Team
Saleroom & Specialist Team

Seeing what our clients truly want,
and finding the very best way to achieve it.
Exceeding expectations, delivering moments.
That is the spirit we bring, every season,
to every lot we are trusted with.

Record results at the rostrum,
rare watches and fine art and
landmark single-owner sales —
the harder the brief,

Our Commitment

Our Business What we sell, and how we sell it.

  • Live Auctions

    Valuation, cataloguing, marketing and sale — handled under one roof.
    We walk with you from first idea to final settlement.

  • Featured Lots

    From signature single-owner collections to design, watches and motor cars,
    we cover an exceptional range of categories.

  • Bidding Guide

    Deep specialist research and market analysis behind every estimate.
    Talk to us about your first valuation.

  • The Saleroom

    Viewing galleries, grading rooms and salerooms — all in-house.
    The foundation behind results our clients trust.

  • Private Sales

    Private sales and special single-owner events,
    built entirely around your collection and your goals.

Our Strengths Why sellers and buyers choose us.
Depth of expertise, and
breadth of reach.

  • ( 01 )

    We listen to our clients —
    completely, and in earnest

    Understanding the story behind every piece is where our work begins — then we find its best route to market.

  • ( 02 )

    Rare, even in this business:
    record-level results, season after season

    From single lots to entire estates. The expertise behind results the market trusts.

  • ( 03 )

    Consignment to hammer,
    one team throughout

    Every stage managed in-house: quality, timing and a sale day that runs like clockwork.

  • ( 04 )

    For the hardest cases,
    seasoned specialists

    Provenance disputes, rare categories, tight deadlines — we handle the difficult with care.

  • ( 05 )

    In our own viewing galleries,
    quality you can verify

    Condition, authenticity and grading checked in-house — proof that stands up anywhere.

  • ( 06 )

    For every kind of need,
    real flexibility

    One lot or one thousand, any category, any timeline — we shape the sale around you.
